doc-2aba9adbee1b08bb26aa69ae2da5f285.content:
Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022 - NSW Planning Controls

Building Height Restrictions:
- Residential buildings: Maximum height of 8.5 metres allowed in most residential zones
- Commercial buildings: Maximum height of 12 metres in mixed use zones  
- Height measured from natural ground level to roof peak
- Additional height may be permitted for architectural features

Floor Space Ratio (FSR) Controls:
- Residential zones (R1, R2): Maximum FSR of 0.6:1 applies
- Mixed use zones (B4): Maximum FSR of 1.2:1 applies  
- Additional FSR available through affordable housing or community contribution schemes
- FSR calculated as total floor space divided by site area

Building Setback Requirements:
- Front boundary: Minimum 6 metre setback required for residential buildings
- Side boundaries: Minimum 1.5 metre setback for single storey, 2 metres for two storey
- Rear boundary: Minimum 6 metre setback from rear property line
- Reduced setbacks may apply in commercial zones

Parking Requirements:
- Residential: Minimum 1 parking space per dwelling unit
- Visitor parking: 1 space per 4 dwelling units in residential developments
- Commercial: 1 space per 25m² of retail floor space
- Accessible parking: Minimum 1 space per 50 parking spaces

Development Controls:
- Development consent required for most building work
- Exempt development includes minor alterations under 10m²
- Complying development pathways available for standard residential work
- Heritage conservation areas have additional controls

Planning Zones:
- R1 General Residential: Single dwellings, dual occupancies permitted
- R2 Low Density Residential: Multi dwelling housing up to 3 storeys
- R3 Medium Density Residential: Residential flat buildings, townhouses
- B4 Mixed Use: Commercial and residential uses permitted
- RE1 Public Recreation: Public recreation facilities only
